nodes.description: Private string state variable holding the token name 'BB Erzurumspor Token', passed to ERC20 constructor.
Private string state variable holding the token symbol 'ERZ', passed to ERC20 constructor.
Private uint8 state variable holding decimals value 2, returned by decimals().
Private uint state variable holding the initial supply 25000000000 minted in the constructor.
Public constant bytes32 role identifier keccak256('BURNER_ROLE') used to gate the burn function.
Constructor that sets up DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE for msg.sender and mints the initial supply.
Public burn function that requires the caller to hold BURNER_ROLE, then burns tokens from an arbitrary 'from' address.
Public view override returning the custom __decimals value (2).
Untrusted caller address used for role setup, role checks and mint recipient.
Internal burn operation invoked by burn(); reduces balance and total supply of an attacker-influenced target address.
Internal mint operation invoked by the constructor to create the initial supply.
Address parameter of burn() specifying the account whose tokens are destroyed.
uint256 parameter of burn() specifying the number of tokens to destroy.

edges.reason: burn() derives the caller identity from _msgSender() (msg.sender) for the hasRole(BURNER_ROLE) authorization check.
The constructor grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE to msg.sender, establishing attacker-influenced initial privileges.
BURNER_ROLE is the value consumed by the hasRole requirement that guards burn().
The 'from' parameter flows directly into the _burn operation, allowing the burner to destroy tokens of an arbitrary address.
The 'amount' parameter flows directly into the _burn operation.
burn() invokes the internal ERC20._burn operation on the supplied account and amount.
The constructor invokes the internal ERC20._mint operation to create the initial supply.
__INITIAL_SUPPLY is read inside the constructor for the initial mint.
__INITIAL_SUPPLY is passed as the amount argument to _mint.
__decimals is returned by the decimals() override.
msg.sender is the recipient of the initial minted supply.
__name is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor for token metadata initialization.
__symbol is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor for token metadata initialization.

normalization_plan.reason: burn.from is a parameter that only exists to feed the burn() function and its _burn call; fold it into the burn function node.
burn.amount is a parameter that only exists to feed the burn() function and its _burn call; fold it into the burn function node.
